Hi Alex,

A colleague at ShipBob shared that when they loaded 500 repositories across 27 teams, the engineering velocity jumped three‑fold while commit‑to‑push times fell 50%. It seems the sheer scale and coordination of codebases is generating hidden overhead and manual reconciliation work.

We’ve helped operations teams automate those reconciliation‑heavy processes, freeing engineers to focus on delivery. Could we explore if a similar approach could streamline your workflows?

Best,
Zamp
